name: Survey tile in Leo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.7 degrees north of the ecliptic in Leo, imaged by SPHEREx 9 times in 6 visits over 52 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 18 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.2 days starting 2026-05-08, at wavelengths from 1.66 to 4.99 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
